page_specific_questions: Does JPG to PNG make the background transparent?
No. JPG has no transparency, so the new PNG keeps the same background. To remove a background you need a separate background remover.

PNG is lossless, so photos usually become larger when saved as PNG. Keep the JPG if file size matters.

tools.purpose: Join multiple PDF files into a single document without uploading them to a converter server. Choose the files in the order you want them combined, then download the merged PDF.
tools.important_details: Files are merged in the order shown after selection. Large PDFs can use substantial device memory. Password-protected or damaged documents may fail to open.
tools.additional_details: Use this PDF merger to combine PDF files into one, whether you want to join two PDFs, merge invoices or put scanned pages together. To add pages to an existing PDF, merge it with another PDF that holds the new pages. To merge a PDF and a JPG, turn the picture into a PDF with Image to PDF first, then merge both PDFs here.
steps: Choose at least two PDF files from your device.
Check their displayed order; the files are merged in that order.
Select Merge PDFs and save the combined document.
common_questions: Can I merge PDF files for free?
page_specific_questions: How do I combine two PDFs into one?
Select both PDF files, check the order, then merge and download the combined file.
Can I add pages to an existing PDF?
Yes. Merge your existing PDF with a second PDF that has the pages you want to add. Use Extract PDF Pages afterwards if you need to remove some.
How do I merge a PDF and a JPG into one PDF?
Convert the JPG to a PDF with our Image to PDF tool, then select that PDF together with your other PDF here and merge them in the order you want.
Can I merge PDF files online for free without uploading them?
Yes. The files are merged in your browser and are not uploaded to SnapKit. There is no sign-up.
Can I split and merge PDF files online?
Yes. Use Split PDF to break a document into pages or parts, and this tool to merge PDFs again in a new order.

tools.purpose: Create a smaller PDF containing only the pages you need. Enter page numbers or ranges such as 1-3,5, then download the extracted pages as a new PDF.
tools.important_details: Page numbers start at 1. For example, 1-3,5 keeps pages 1, 2, 3, and 5, in that order. The original PDF remains unchanged on your device.
tools.additional_details: Only need a few pages from a long document? Extract them into one new, smaller PDF. To break a PDF into several files at once, such as one file per page, use Split PDF.
steps: Choose one PDF from your device.
Enter the pages to keep, for example 1-3,5.
Select Extract Pages and download the new PDF.
common_questions: Can I extract PDF pages without uploading the file?
page_specific_questions: How do I separate pages from a PDF?
Choose the PDF, type the pages to keep (for example 2 or 4-6), and select Extract Pages. The pages are saved as a new PDF and the original stays unchanged.
Does the original PDF change?
No. A new PDF is created and your original file stays unchanged.
What is the difference between extract and split?
Extract keeps the pages you choose in one new PDF. Split cuts the whole document into several PDFs at once, for example one file per page.

tools.purpose: Create a PNG copy of an SVG graphic for apps, forms, or websites that need a raster image. Select an SVG file and download the PNG made by your browser.
tools.important_details: The browser rasterizes the SVG at its intrinsic size. SVG features that rely on external fonts, images, or resources may look different or may not load. Keep the SVG original for scalable editing.
tools.additional_details: SVG is great for logos and icons, but many sites, apps and documents only accept raster images. This SVG to PNG converter makes a PNG copy you can upload anywhere.
page_specific_questions: Will my PNG be sharp?
PNG is made of pixels, so it is sharp at the size it is created. The converter uses the SVG’s own size, so very small SVGs give small PNGs.
Why does my SVG look different as PNG?
SVGs that depend on external fonts or images may not render exactly the same in a browser.

tools.important_details: OCR (optical character recognition) reads letters in a picture and turns them into text you can edit. Accuracy depends on the image: clear printed text works best, while handwriting and blurry photos work poorly.
tools.additional_details: Use this free OCR online tool to copy text out of a picture instead of typing it again. It works with photos of documents, screenshots, signs and scanned pages, and you can save the result as a text file or a Word document.
steps: Choose one or more images from your device.
Pick the text language, English, Bangla or both.
Select Extract text, check the result, then copy or download it.
common_questions: Is this online OCR tool free?
Yes. It is free and needs no account. Your browser does the processing.
page_specific_questions: What is OCR?
OCR stands for optical character recognition. It finds letters in an image and converts them to text you can edit and search.
Why is some of my text wrong?
OCR can misread blurry, small or decorative text, and handwriting is usually not recognized well. Use a sharp, high-resolution image and proofread the result.
tools.privacy: Images are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to SnapKit. The OCR engine downloads from a public CDN on first use.
tools.limitations: OCR works best on sharp, well-lit images with clear printed text. Blurry photos, handwriting, unusual fonts or low contrast reduce accuracy. Try a higher-resolution image, or crop closer to the text.

tools.purpose: Make photos and images smaller for forms, email, websites and messaging apps. Choose one or many images, set the quality or a maximum size in KB, and download the compressed copies.
tools.important_details: JPG and WebP are compressed with an adjustable quality setting. If you set a maximum size such as 100 KB, the tool lowers quality first and then reduces the dimensions in small steps until the file fits. PNG is lossless, so for a much smaller file choose WebP or JPG; JPG does not keep transparent areas.
tools.additional_details: Use this image compressor to reduce photo size for online forms, email attachments, websites and chat apps. Pick a quality level, or enter a target such as 50 KB, 100 KB or 200 KB and let the tool find the smallest file that fits. You can compress several pictures at once.
steps: Choose one or more images from your device.
Set the quality, or enter a maximum size in KB (for example 100) and optionally a maximum width.
Select Compress, then download each compressed image.
common_questions: Is this image compressor free?
Yes. It is free, needs no account, and has no daily limit set by SnapKit. Your device's memory limits very large images.
page_specific_questions: How do I compress an image to 100 KB?

Choose your image, type 100 in the Max size (KB) box, and select Compress. The tool lowers the quality and, if needed, the dimensions until the file is under 100 KB. The same steps work for 50 KB, 200 KB or any other size.
How do I reduce the size of a JPG photo without losing visible quality?

Start with a quality around 70 to 80. Most photos look the same on screen at that level while the file becomes much smaller. If you need a smaller file, lower the quality further or reduce the maximum width.
Can I compress a PNG?
PNG is lossless, so changing quality does not shrink it. For a much smaller file choose WebP or JPG as the output, or set a maximum size. JPG does not keep transparent areas; WebP does.
Can I compress multiple images at once?
Yes. Select several images, compress them together, and download each result or use Download all.
How do I reduce a picture from MB to KB?
Set a maximum size in KB, for example 200, and optionally a maximum width such as 1920 px. Large camera photos often shrink from several MB to a few hundred KB with little visible change.
tools.privacy: No. Images are read and compressed in your browser and the result is downloaded to your device. GitHub Pages may process normal website request logs as the host.
tools.limitations: Very large images, or formats your browser cannot read, may fail. Try a current browser, or convert the image to JPG or PNG first. HEIC support depends on your device.

common_questions: Is this PDF splitter free?
Yes. It is free, needs no account, and runs in your browser.
page_specific_questions: How do I split a PDF into separate pages?
Choose the PDF, pick Every page as its own PDF and select Split PDF. You get one file per page, which you can download one by one or as a ZIP.
Can I split a PDF by page range?
Yes. Choose the ranges mode and type ranges such as 1-3, 4-6, 9. Each range becomes its own PDF.
Can I split a PDF into equal parts?
Yes. Choose One PDF for every N pages. With 10 pages and N = 5 you get two PDFs of five pages each.
How do I split and merge PDF files?
Split the document here, then use Merge PDF to combine any of the pieces in the order you want.

tools.purpose: Some online forms, exam portals and job applications accept only very small pictures. This page opens the image compressor with a 50 KB limit already filled in, so you can shrink a photo or scan and download a file under 50 KB.
tools.important_details: 50 KB is a tight limit. A passport-style photo or a signature image usually fits, but a large detailed photo may have to be scaled down to a few hundred pixels wide and loses some quality. If the tool cannot reach 50 KB it tells you; try a smaller maximum width.
tools.additional_details: Use this page when a form says the file must be under 50 KB. The result is the highest quality that still fits the limit, so it usually lands a little below 50 KB rather than exactly on it.
steps: Choose your photo, signature or scan.
Keep the 50 KB limit (you can change it) and optionally set a maximum width.
Select Compress, check the pixel size shown, and download the file.
common_questions: Is this 50 KB image compressor free?
Yes. It is free, needs no account, and runs in your browser.
page_specific_questions: How do I make a photo 50 KB or less?
Choose the photo, leave the limit at 50, and select Compress. The tool lowers quality, then the dimensions in small steps, until the file fits.
Will my photo look blurry at 50 KB?
Small files need lower quality or fewer pixels, so some softness is possible. For passport-size photos and signatures it is usually hard to notice at normal size.
Why is my result under 50 KB, not exactly 50?
The tool picks the best quality that is at or below your limit. A result a few KB under the limit is normal.
tools.privacy: No. Images are read and compressed in your browser and the result is downloaded to your device. GitHub Pages may process normal website request logs as the host.
tools.limitations: Very large images, or formats your browser cannot read, may fail. Try a current browser, or convert the image to JPG or PNG first.

tools.purpose: Profile photos, document scans and application forms often ask for images under 100 KB. This page opens the image compressor with a 100 KB limit already filled in, so one click gets you a smaller copy.

page_specific_questions: How do I compress a JPG to 100 KB?
Choose the JPG, keep the limit at 100 and select Compress. The tool finds the highest quality that fits under 100 KB and reduces the dimensions only if it must.
Can I compress a PNG to 100 KB?
Yes, but PNG is lossless. When you set a size limit, the PNG is saved as WebP (or JPG if WebP is unavailable) so it can reach the target.
Can I compress several images to 100 KB at once?
Yes. Select multiple images; each one is compressed to its own file under the limit.
